events.text: Trotha was deployed to Africa.

events.quote: he was deployed to Africa in 1894

events.text: Trotha was appointed commander of the colonial forces in German East Africa.
events.subject: self
events.object: colonial forces in German East Africa
events.quote: In 1894 Trotha was appointed commander of the colonial forces in German East Africa

events.text: Trotha was successful in suppressing uprisings there, including the Wahehe Rebellion.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1894 Trotha was appointed commander of the colonial forces in German East Africa and was ruthlessly successful in suppressing uprisings there

events.text: Trotha was appointed Commander in Chief of German South West Africa.
events.subject: self
events.object: Commander in Chief of German South West Africa
events.quote: On 3 May 1904 he was appointed Commander in Chief of German South West Africa

events.text: Trotha was directed to crush the native Herero rebellion.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 3 May 1904 he was appointed Commander in Chief of German South West Africa and was directed to crush the native Herero rebellion

events.text: Trotha arrived in South West Africa.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Trotha arrived in South West Africa on 11 June 1904

events.text: Trotha devised a new battle plan to end the uprisings by the Herero.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In October 1904 General von Trotha devised a new battle plan to end the uprisings by the Herero

events.text: Trotha issued orders to encircle the Herero on three sides at the Battle of Waterberg.
events.subject: self
events.quote: At the Battle of Waterberg , he issued orders to encircle the Herero on three sides

events.text: Trotha ordered his troops to poison water holes, erect guard posts along a 150-mile line and shoot on sight any Herero.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Trotha ordered his troops to poison water holes , erect guard posts along a 150-mile line and shoot on sight any Herero

events.text: Trotha issued the Vernichtungsbefehl, or extermination order.

events.quote: Trotha then issued the Vernichtungsbefehl , or extermination order

events.text: Trotha defended his policies later in his life.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Trotha defended his policies later in his life .

events.text: He sent a message to the Nama suggesting they surrender.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 22 April 1905 he sent a message to the Nama , suggesting they surrender

events.text: Lothar von Trotha returned to Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 19 November 1905 Lothar von Trotha returned to Germany

events.text: Lothar von Trotha was appointed as an infantry general.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was appointed as an infantry general in 1910

events.text: Lothar von Trotha died of typhoid fever ( bilious fever ) in Bonn.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He died of typhoid fever ( bilious fever ) on 31 March 1920 in Bonn

events.text: The Nazi authorities had named a street in Munich as von Trotha Straße.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1933 , the Nazi authorities had named a street in Munich as von Trotha Straße .

events.text: The Munich city council officially decided to change the name of this street to Herero Straße.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2006 the Munich city council officially decided to change the name of this street to Herero Straße in honour of the generals victims .

events.text: Calls to rename this street surfaced.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2016 , calls to rename this street surfaced , and the municipality promised to initiate the renaming in 2017 .

events.text: The German government under Gerhard Schröder officially apologized for the genocide.
events.subject: other
events.quote: On 16 August 2004 the German government under Gerhard Schröder officially apologized for the genocide

events.text: The German government rejected calls to pay reparations to the descendants of the Herero and Nama.
events.subject: other
events.quote: On 16 August 2004 the German government under Gerhard Schröder officially apologized for the genocide , but rejected calls to pay reparations

events.text: Heidemarie Wieczorek-Zeul admitted the massacres were equivalent to genocide.

events.text: The German government officially recognized the genocide.

events.quote: In May 2021 , the German government officially recognized the genocide

events.text: The German government agreed to pay €1.1 billion over 30 years to fund projects in communities that were impacted by the genocide.
